observations: body L3-L5: the Arabic verses are transcribed with the vowel signs as printed; the third verse has no vowel on the ت of أكتبرح, the second none on the first ي of يليز and on the hamza of وهاء.
body L8: «zabaḥ» is printed with a dot under the h, against the ه of زبه in the verse (h = 5).
body L11: the Syriac word is printed in Serto with a vowel sign over the resh, transcribed as zqapha.
body L18: «adp. C» is printed so, for «adn. C».
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
